caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate pedestal or candlestick placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The object is rendered in shades of gray, giving it a metallic or stone-like appearance. It has a wide, round top, a slender neck with a small ringed section, a bulbous central portion, and transitions downward into a fluted base that flares outward in a symmetrical, decorative pattern. The base is supported by a square plinth. The object is detailed with careful shading and highlights, indicating a smooth, reflective surface. There is a small inscription in the bottom left corner of the drawing. No additional objects or background details are included in the composition.
